description: This is a FastAPI route module for managing equipment records, including listing, fetching, creating, updating, and deleting equipment. It interfaces with a database and requires authentication and role-based authorization.

methods.name: list[EquipmentOut] list_equipment( q: str | None = Query(None, description="Optional search by asset_tag or name"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list equipment, with optional search query.

methods.name: EquipmentOut get_equipment( equipment_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific equipment by ID.

methods.name: EquipmentOut create_equipment( payload: EquipmentCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_roles("ADMIN", "ENGINEER")), )
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new equipment record. Requires admin or engineer role.

methods.name: EquipmentOut update_equipment( equipment_id: int, payload: EquipmentUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_roles("ADMIN", "ENGINEER")), )
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing equipment record. Requires admin or engineer role.

methods.name: None delete_equipment( equipment_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_roles("ADMIN")), )
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove equipment. Requires admin role.
